---
title: inif.viewer
description: Render an InifDocument as a self-contained interactive HTML page.

Three flavours of the same renderer: get the HTML string, write it to
disk, or display inline in Jupyter. See [HTML viewer](../workflows/viewer.qmd)
for what the rendered page looks like and the available options.
